stable.title: Echoes of Elsewhere
stable.statusNote: Current Living Wilds 1.1.0 local browser demo. Python 3.10+ and a modern browser are required. Extract the complete ZIP and run launch.py. The actual state/action/save server is included; no account or external service is required.

stable.title: War Table
stable.statusNote: Linux x86-64 local browser development demo. Requires Python 3.10+ and a modern browser; Java 25 and the pinned TripleA runtime are included. Extract the complete ZIP, run sh Start-War-Table.sh, then open http://127.0.0.1:8795/play. If needed, run sh Start-War-Table.sh --port 8796 and open http://127.0.0.1:8796/play. Personal saves are excluded.
buildNotes: Qualified finite development demo: ten scenarios. Existing ordinary-input opening checks cover Atheria start, recruitment, move, undo and Resume. This archive received integrity and launcher checks; a new extracted-package gameplay run and full-war, audio/art and mobile acceptance are not claimed.
